source.text: All entries › Reasoning Model Copy as Markdown Copied ← → Reasoning Model You might say AI has been thinking for so long—is it stuck? A model that runs internal reasoning before answering, trading longer thinking time for accuracy on harder tasks·For multi-file bug investigations or complex step-by-step logic, reasoning models generate an internal thought process before delivering the final answer. This background deliberation increases wait time and token costs; using it for straightforward text edits or simple lookups is unnecessarily slow and expensive.
